description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git patch-id' functionality. It contains test setup commands, definitions of helper functions for calculating patch IDs, and multiple test cases validating the behavior of patch ID calculations under various conditions.

methods.name: calc_patch_id
methods.description: Calculates the patch ID for a given patch name and optional arguments, outputs a single line with the ID.

methods.name: get_top_diff
methods.description: Retrieves the top diff for the specified revisions, including only the patch without the full log.

methods.name: get_patch_id
methods.description: Gets the top diff and calculates the patch ID for a specific revision or range.

methods.name: cmp_patch_id
methods.description: Compares two patch ID files and verifies if they are equal or not based on the first argument.
